subject_definitions:
- Image 1 = Woman A (the pursuer). A woman whose face, hairstyle, body
  type, and outfit strictly match the reference image "Image 1". In this
  scene she holds a compact semi-automatic pistol and runs with a
  controlled, disciplined gait.
- Image 2 = Woman B (the fleeing target). A woman whose face, hairstyle,
  body type, and outfit strictly match the reference image "Image 2". In
  this scene she runs empty-handed, leaning forward, constantly scanning
  both walls for an exit.

summary:
A single continuous 15-second hand-held take in a rain-soaked urban alley
at night: Woman A (Image 1) pursues Woman B (Image 2) on foot, fires two
warning shots without hitting her, and catches up as B slams into a dead
end, ending in a two-shot standoff.

retention_analysis:
Both reference subjects remain visible for the entire 15 seconds; Image 1
and Image 2 must keep their faces, hair, and clothing identical to the
reference images in every frame. The pistol is a new prop introduced in
the scene (held by Image 1 only); it is not part of either reference
image and must not appear on Image 2. The environment (wet alley,
sodium lamps, cyan neon, chained gate dead end) is scene-only and never
appears in the reference images. No third person may enter frame.

detailed_description:
Single take, 35mm, low angle, hand-held with natural bump. No cuts.

Shot 1 (0-5s): Low-angle medium-wide, camera tracking behind and slightly
to the right of Woman A (Image 1), moving forward at running pace.
Woman B (Image 2) runs 4-5 meters ahead in alley depth, back to camera,
silhouetted against a far warm sodium street lamp. Both women run
without breaking stride; A closes the gap slowly and deliberately.
Wet asphalt reflects warm sodium light and distant cyan neon; overhead
wiring and fire escapes frame the alley; dumpsters and crates line the
walls.

Shot 2 (5-10s): Camera continues the forward track behind A. A raises
the pistol in one hand without slowing and fires two quick single shots;
muzzle flash is a split-second burst that briefly lights B's back and
the wet wall - the only strong light source in the scene; muzzle smoke
lasts at most one frame. B (Image 2) is NOT hit; she ducks under a
hanging pipe, rounds spark off the concrete behind her, her pace turns
frantic, and she turns the corner into the dead end.

Shot 3 (10-15s): B (Image 2) hits a wall of chained gates, slams into
it, spins around mid-stride, one hand braced on wet concrete, back
flushed against the gate. The camera executes a hard whip-stop exactly
as B turns. A (Image 1) slides to a stop 2 meters in front of B,
lowering the pistol to a two-handed ready position, expression
unreadable. Final 1 second: held stillness, B against the chained gate,
A in the foreground, rain mist hanging in the warm lamplight.

Camera movement is one continuous forward tracking move with hand-held
shake and a single hard stop at 10 seconds; the frame never cuts.

overall_soundscape:
Diegetic sound only. Wet clattering footsteps echoing off the narrow
alley walls throughout (0-12s), sharp high-pitched female panting from
both women, two short crisp gunshots with a 0.5-second alley echo
around 5-10s, a dull body-against-metal-gate thud at about 11s, then a
full second of near-silence with only faint residual breathing and
distant city low-frequency ambience.

non_diegetic_music:
None. Pure diegetic mix; optionally one low sustained cello/string drone
from 0-15s at very low volume under the footsteps, rising slightly at
the 10s whip-stop and cutting out at the final stillness.
